entry.name: jit.gl.environment
entry.digest: Manage environment textures for image-based lighting (IBL)
entry.description: The jit.gl.environment object utilizes internal jit.gl.cubemap and jit.openexr objects for loading and uploading equirectangular exr environment maps. Once loaded the data is converted as needed and passed to requesting objects. Environments are bound to jit.gl.node sub-contexts, and only a single environment can be active in the sub-context at a time.

attributes.name: reflect_edge
attributes.digest: Reflection Map Edge Length
attributes.description: Set the length of the generated reflection map edge (default = 128). Higher values improve the resolution and perceived quality of PBR reflections (most notably on flat surfaces), at the expense of longer loading time and greater GPU memory usage. Changing this value causes the reflection map to regenerate, which will stall the renderer.
